scripts.check:generated: test -z "$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=all -- src/generated)" || { git status --short --untracked-files=all -- src/generated; echo 'Commit or discard these src/generated changes first: the check regenerates over them.' >&2; exit 1; }; pnpm run generate && git diff --exit-code -- src/generated && test -z "$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=all -- src/generated)"
